# rank · v1.1.0

Source: https://rank.hexdocs.pm/

# rank

Ordinals for numbers, e.g. 1st, 2nd, 3rd

```
gleam add rank@1
```
```
import rank
pub fn main() {
  rank.ordinalise(1) // "1st"
  rank.ordinalise(2) // "2nd"
  rank.ordinalise(3) // "3rd"
  rank.suffix(1) // "st"
  rank.suffix(2) // "nd"
  rank.suffix(3) // "rd"
}
```
Documentation can be found at [https://hexdocs.pm/rank](https://hexdocs.pm/rank).

Thanks to [Andrew Hao’s Ordinal](https://github.com/andrewhao/ordinal) which
was the inspiration for this library.

---

# rank

Ordinals for numbers, e.g. 1st, 2nd, 3rd

# rank · rank · v1.1.0

Source: https://rank.hexdocs.pm/rank.html

`pub fn ordinalise(number: Int) -> String`Convert a number to its ordinal form.

# Examples

```
ordinalise(1) // -> "1st"
ordinalise(2) // -> "2nd"
ordinalise(3) // -> "3rd"
ordinalise(4) // -> "4th"
```
`pub fn ordinalise(number: Int) -> String`Convert a number to its ordinal form.

```
ordinalise(1) // -> "1st"
ordinalise(2) // -> "2nd"
ordinalise(3) // -> "3rd"
ordinalise(4) // -> "4th"
```
